# SIB Consulting — Team SIB
# https://www.teamsib.com

## About
SIB Consulting operates Team SIB, a multi-sector strategic intelligence and transformation practice based in Dubai, UAE. Team SIB serves organisations, industries and governments across the GCC and MENA region, with Agentic AI orchestrating across every domain.

## Primary Domain
https://www.teamsib.com

## What we do
SIB Consulting delivers intelligence-led transformation across ten domains, each led by a named domain expert:

1. Agentic AI & Autonomous Systems — Lisa Warren
2. Sustainability & ESG — Ivano Iannelli
3. Supply Chain & Process — Dr. Patrick McCrudden
4. Architecture & Interior Design — Keith Elliott
5. Education — Dr. Bill Lehal
6. Healthcare — Dr. Manish Mehrotra
7. IT & Digital — Christopher Morley
8. Strategic Planning — Dr. Alex Jones
9. AI Governance — Lisa Warren & Ivano Iannelli
10. AI Training — Lisa Warren
